title: HiringReconciliationRecord
description: Execution-time reconciliation: the hiring-domain comparison of the AUTHORIZED action against the EXECUTED action and the resulting HRIS state, emitting RECONCILED / DEVIATION / PARTIAL / FAILED / UNKNOWN. The shared cross-system reconciliation ENGINE stays external (ReconciliationPort); this record is the hiring-domain view only, optionally referencing the external run. (Post-hire 1/3/6/12-month predicted-vs-actual reconciliation and calibration is a separate concern — see review_and_calibration.schema.json.) Tracks ugence_ai_hiring.hiring_decision.execution.HiringReconciliationRecord.

status.description: RECONCILED: executed == authorized and HRIS state confirms. DEVIATION: executed differs. PARTIAL: executed matches but HRIS state unconfirmed. FAILED: execution failed. UNKNOWN: outcome unknown / no executed action.

external_reconciliation_ref.description: Reference from the shared Reconciliation engine (ReconciliationPort), when invoked.
